action: Started: Validating golf-league: pricing paid league tools from their own pages and searching for a free tool that runs a whole league

Priced paid tools from own pages: GolfSoftware 8 USD per golfer a year (12 min), Golf League Network 9.50 to 10.50 USD per golfer capped 570 to 630 a league, Golf League Tracker 119 USD a league a season, Handicap Tracker app 49.99 USD a year

Page one check (web search, 21 Nov 2026): golf league software and golf league management software are held by GolfSoftware.com, Golf League Tracker, Golf League Network, LiveTourney blog, Capterra, SourceForge and App Store pages; free searches surface Squabbit

Killed golf-league: Squabbit Free already runs a whole league (league handicaps and subs, every format, recurring events, live season standings, public event site) with 5.6K ratings at 4.9; League Pro only adds stats and admin polish (squabbitgolf.com/pricing.html)
